messages:
Maya Singh: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get firm owners + realistic ship windows for API / Console / Optimize? teams need to finalize sprint scope. :wave:

Owen Brooks: short answers: API hosted parity -> target GA 2026-07-20 (soft GA). Console opt-in beta -> target 2026-06-29. Optimize (cost hints + batching) -> alpha target 2026-08-12. owners below. :memo:

Rita Chen: are any of these blocked on Dedicated rollout or telemetry? need explicit deps for partner teams.

Owen Brooks: hosted API GA is NOT gated on Dedicated. Optimize alpha requires stable runtime telemetry (per-request token counts). Console beta is opt-in and non-breaking.

Carlos Vega: proposed owners:
- API GA: Owen Brooks (PM) + Maya Singh (Eng lead)
- Console beta: Rita Chen (Product) + Carlos Vega (DevEx)
- Optimize alpha: Carlos Vega (ML infra) + Owen Brooks (Product)
I'll create a tiny checklist doc and a weekly 15m sync.

DevEx-bot: All-hands recording + slides: https://meet.corp/rec/2487654300 (follow-up doc link to be attached) :movie_camera:

Maya Singh: can we get a copyable canary plan snippet (traffic ramps, rollback signals, duration) for runbooks?

Owen Brooks: paste canary template to copy:
```
canary:
  steps: [1,5,20]
  step_days: 3
  total_days: 9
  rollback_if:
    - "5xx_rate > 0.5%"
    - "p95_latency > baseline * 1.25"
    - "user_error_rate_increase > 2%"
```
Use feature flags for Console beta.

Rita Chen: telemetry stabilization ETA: 2026-06-21 (current sprint). if it slips, Optimize alpha moves +3w. I'll post weekly updates.

Carlos Vega: checklist fields: owner, target date, canary window, rollback triggers, docs owner, SDK notes, partner migration notes. drafting v1 and will share link.

Maya Singh: action items:
- Rita: telemetry status updates weekly until 2026-06-21
- Maya: finalize API canary + health checks by 2026-06-24
- Carlos: checklist doc + owners by 2026-06-10
- Owen: assign marketing liaison + draft release bullets by 2026-06-18
I'll add the calendar invites. :calendar:

Owen Brooks: if any team expects >10 day slip, please flag this thread so we can re-evaluate priorities. :thumbsup:
